fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. John 4:39 says many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman's testimony. Her words were, “He told me everything I ever did.” She told them what happened, and they believed. A simple story, passed along.
No gifts here, friend. The Samaritans believed because of the woman's testimony, and her words were, “He told me everything I ever did.” (John 4:39) Her words are what they pointed to.
